desc: A legendary abyss demon, small humanoid with curved horns, deep navy skin with lighter violet highlights, small bat wings, thin tail, fierce crimson eyes, tattered violet robe. High quality 16-bit pixel art game pet, crisp pixels, right-facing 3/4 view, full body with empty margin, dark violet outline, pixel cluster shading with clear light and shadow, palette of lavender, pale violet, cream, ivory and deep navy, no background.
